rules: Save/load is serialization of authoritative state, not regeneration.
Missing optional presentation data may be rebuilt only from persistent identity and authoritative state.
Identity-affecting data may not be reconstructed from a fresh random roll.
LOD unload/reload preserves stable identity and authoritative history.
Offline catch-up may append valid events and mutate current state but cannot reroll identity.
Migration is explicit, versioned and auditable.
A failed or incomplete migration must retain the old persisted result or fail safely; it cannot silently replace the entity.
